purpose: Define how LangGraph should become the orchestration layer for Brain's knowledge, memory, and decision relationship without uncontrolled memory writes

langgraph_role.orchestration: Route each run through memory retrieval at the memory_retrieval node
langgraph_role.evidence_linking: Attach evidence source IDs to retrieved context and any candidate memory
langgraph_role.separation: Keep accepted memory separate from candidate memory
langgraph_role.mutation_guard: Prevent silent memory mutation; all writes require explicit tool/front approval
langgraph_role.audit_trail: TraceStore records retrieval attempts, source IDs, and governance decisions

safeguards: No write to memory/semantic without explicit front
No FAISS rebuild without explicit front
Candidate memory must be validated before promotion

brain_relationship.principle: LangGraph should orchestrate Brain, not replace Brain
brain_relationship.brain_role: Brain remains the domain system owning CEI/FDOT, trading, research, and project knowledge
brain_relationship.langgraph_role: LangGraph becomes the controlled agentic runtime around Brain tools, memory, and governance

durable_execution_mapping.durable execution: LangGraph checkpoints and resume paths protect long-running reasoning
durable_execution_mapping.stateful workflows: Graph state carries run context, mode, plan, and evidence source IDs across nodes
durable_execution_mapping.human-in-the-loop: LangGraph interrupts or governance gate pauses for approval_required mode
durable_execution_mapping.traces: TraceStore + capability_metadata node provide per-run traceability
durable_execution_mapping.rollback: CheckpointStore + env-based backend fallback provide dual rollback paths
durable_execution_mapping.memory: memory_retrieval node integrates accepted memory; candidate memory kept separate
durable_execution_mapping.knowledge growth: Evidence-linked retrieval feeds candidate memory; promotion requires human approval
durable_execution_mapping.relationship with Brain/AI_Vault: LangGraph executes on behalf of Brain's goals without usurping domain ownership
durable_execution_mapping.long-term goal execution: Graph nodes can be decomposed into future sub-agent roles after default stabilization
